scenario: Multi-justification lifecycle, full withdrawal: a keyed logical fact emitted by two rules retracts cleanly only when ALL justifiers are withdrawn, leaving no orphan. A runtime that builds a second DS wrapper orphans it on the TMS retract (dangling rete_fact, never emits FACT_RETRACT), and working memory keeps 1 stale Mark instead of 0.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key
schema Gate scope logical:
    g: Int key
schema Mark scope logical:
    step: String key
rule from_trig:
    Trig
->
    emit Mark logical step: "X"
rule from_gate:
    Gate
->
    emit Mark logical step: "X"
